about.title: About
about.lead: I'm a programmer who loves problem-solving, finding ways to do things I didn't know I could, and probably likes debugging more than I should.
paragraphs: I also have an inner artist I can't seem to suppress. Interactive media became my outlet for that side: a way to create and express the parts of me that a program with a fixed expected output can't show.
What I want next is to break problems apart with people who learn from each other, pick up new tools and build new connections along the way.
